purpose: TAKY durable storage and distribution routing. GitHub owns governance/code; HNS owns internal master data; SIEZEALL owns approved user distribution; SAVEY is a separate top-level system.
routing_rules: All TAKY Drive material must live below TAKY root.
SAVEY is a separate top-level system and must not be nested below TAKY.
HNS is internal/master; SIEZEALL is approved distribution/user-sync only.
User-facing PWA must not expose Drive folder structure, provider credentials, refresh tokens or privileged URLs.
Runtime package download is app-internal and automatic only when Wi-Fi is positively confirmed.
If network type cannot be confirmed, large automatic package download waits; local app execution continues.
PWA writes local-first and queues sync; remote acknowledgement never blocks local interaction.
Package sync uses manifest/version/hash comparison and downloads changed packages only.
Package activation occurs only after hash verification and safe-point activation; rollback keeps previous known-good package.
GitHub stores code/schema/manifest pointers, not large runtime corpus or user databases.
Netlify serves PWA shell/runtime delivery only; it is not the primary database or Drive authority.
Deletion candidates move to TAKY/99_DELETE_PENDING; destructive deletion requires explicit human approval.
